independence: Single implementing agent; seven analytical lenses, not independent reviewers or external approval.

lenses.conclusion: Reusable runtime, host, loader, and profile boundaries remain distinct; the display is a bounded fixture, not BH-04 rendering.
Confirmed startup/registry state divergence with the real classes and an injected frame; explicit reportRuntimeLoss tests do not close automatic propagation.
Phase 6 covers five browser scenarios but not actual post-readiness exit propagation. Existing green suites therefore do not establish the milestone exit.
Host lifecycle review does not close manual AT or native role gaps; BH-02 automated semantics remain historical evidence only.
Acquisition checks same-origin, redirect, MIME, exact bytes and SHA-256 before activation; this is not production threat-model closure. Stale-ready state blocks lifecycle acceptance.
No new production dependency, toolkit, renderer, or server authority introduced; runtime remains pinned experimental AtomVM executing AVM, not an AOT UI binary.
Immutable predecessor decisions are preserved. Phase 7 revision-only provenance and coarse/fresh-context measurement limitations remain explicit.

findings.observation: A correlated runtime-exited event after readiness fails/releases startup but leaves the registry scope ready. Subsequent compatible open returns the stale scope. Profile record() never calls reportRuntimeLoss.
findings.required_resolution: Wire active-generation startup loss into registry-owned recovery/fallback. Prove stale-event rejection, intentional shutdown exclusion, single replacement, root replay, and repeated loss convergence in both active browsers; repeat acceptance.

findings.observation: Fresh browser contexts and coarse Chrome heap observations cannot prove long-lived page leak freedom. Firefox heap measurement is unavailable.
findings.required_resolution: Long-duration same-page resource accounting and qualified memory evidence before resource guarantees.

findings.observation: Phase 7 raw evidence names instrumentation commit 2a04d3a, while the final runner/helper was committed in 407bbcd. Completion hashes bind the final runner; the raw revision alone does not identify the complete harness.
findings.required_resolution: Retain historical records; bind exact complete candidate source and fresh repeat evidence in subsequent decisions.
